quality_guards: Scaffold controls depend on design, height, loading, access, weather, public exposure, inspection history and competent supervision.
Scaffolding evidence is structure-, task- and site-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fall or trespass probability.
Roof-work controls depend on roof type, fragility, slope, access, duration, weather, work method and rescue arrangements.
Roof-work evidence is task-, structure- and condition-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fall probability.
Temporary-works controls depend on design assumptions, loads, ground, sequence, equipment, interfaces, inspection and change control.
Temporary-works evidence is design-, project- and condition-specific and is not an exact parcel-level structural-failure probability.
COMAH applicability and controls depend on substance classification, inventory, thresholds, processes, site context and tier status.
COMAH evidence is establishment-, inventory- and scenario-specific and is not an exact parcel-level major-accident probability.
Explosives controls depend on hazard type, net mass, duration, storage construction, separation distance, licence and site security.
Explosives evidence is material-, quantity-, licence- and site-specific and is not an exact parcel-level explosion probability.
Allergen controls depend on ingredients, recipes, suppliers, preparation flow, cross-contact risk, service model and current labelling.
Allergen evidence is product-, process- and consumer-specific and is not an exact parcel-level allergic-reaction probability.
Recall action depends on the exact product, batch, date code, hazard, distribution, consumer group and current alert status.
Food-alert evidence is product-, batch- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level food-safety probability.
Recall significance depends on the exact vehicle or component, model, year, VIN or registration, defect and repair status.
Vehicle-recall evidence is asset- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level road-safety probability.
Radon decisions depend on measured annual average, building type, occupancy, ventilation, ground contact and remediation performance.
Radon evidence is building- and measurement-specific and is not an exact parcel-level indoor-exposure probability.
Food-hygiene controls depend on product, process, temperature history, equipment, staff practice, shelf life and consumer vulnerability.
Food-hygiene evidence is product-, process- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level foodborne-illness probability.
Official-source context is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
